import pytest

from slotplan.align_to_grid import align_to_grid


def test_floor_and_ceil():
    assert align_to_grid(608, 15, "floor") == 600
    assert align_to_grid(601, 15, "ceil") == 615
    assert align_to_grid(-10, 15, "floor") == -15


def test_nearest():
    assert align_to_grid(608) == 615
    assert align_to_grid(645, 30) == 630


def test_bad_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        align_to_grid(600, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        align_to_grid(600, 15, "up")


def test_regression_issue_118():
    assert align_to_grid(645, 30) == 660

acceptance/test_expand_weekly.py.initial:
import pytest

from slotplan.expand_weekly import expand_weekly


def test_plain_series():
    assert expand_weekly([0, 2], 600, 630, 3) == [(0, 600, 630), (2, 600, 630), (7, 600, 630)]
    assert expand_weekly([4, 1, 1], 540, 600, 4) == [(1, 540, 600), (4, 540, 600), (8, 540, 600), (11, 540, 600)]
    assert expand_weekly([3], 540, 600, 0) == []


def test_blackouts():
    assert expand_weekly([0, 2], 600, 630, 4, [(2880, 4320)]) == [(0, 600, 630), (7, 600, 630), (9, 600, 630)]
    assert expand_weekly([1], 540, 600, 2, [(2040, 2160)]) == [(1, 540, 600), (8, 540, 600)]


def test_invalid_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        expand_weekly([7], 540, 600, 2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        expand_weekly([], 540, 600, 2)


def test_regression_issue_590():
    assert expand_weekly([0, 2], 600, 630, 4, [(2880, 4320)]) == [(0, 600, 630), (7, 600, 630), (9, 600, 630), (14, 600, 630)]

import pytest

from slotplan.intervals_overlap import intervals_overlap


def test_overlap_cases():
    assert intervals_overlap((540, 600), (570, 630)) is True
    assert intervals_overlap((540, 720), (600, 630)) is True
    assert intervals_overlap((600, 660), (540, 600)) is False


def test_empty_intervals():
    assert intervals_overlap((600, 600), (540, 660)) is False


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        intervals_overlap((600, 540), (500, 700))

acceptance/test_place_lunch.py.initial:
import pytest

from slotplan.place_lunch import place_lunch


def test_single_option():
    assert place_lunch([(690, 780)]) == (780, 810)
    assert place_lunch([(700, 760), (800, 840)]) == (765, 795)
    assert place_lunch([(690, 840)]) is None


def test_several_options():
    assert place_lunch([]) == (720, 750)
    assert place_lunch([(600, 705)], 45) == (720, 765)
    assert place_lunch([(720, 735)], 15) == (705, 720)


def test_invalid_length():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        place_lunch([], 0)


def test_regression_issue_355():
    assert place_lunch([]) == (690, 720)

acceptance/test_shift_weekly.py.final:
import pytest

from slotplan.shift_weekly import shift_weekly


def test_simple_shift():
    assert shift_weekly([(0, 600, 660)], -120) == [(0, 480, 540)]
    assert shift_weekly([(2, 540, 600), (1, 900, 960)], 330) == [(1, 1230, 1290), (2, 870, 930)]


def test_week_wraps():
    assert shift_weekly([(0, 60, 120)], -120) == [(6, 1380, 1440)]
    assert shift_weekly([(6, 1380, 1410)], 90) == [(0, 30, 60)]


def test_crossing_midnight():
    assert shift_weekly([(4, 1320, 1410)], 60) == [(4, 1380, 1440), (5, 0, 30)]
    assert shift_weekly([(0, 30, 90)], -60) == [(0, 0, 30), (6, 1410, 1440)]


def test_invalid_entry():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        shift_weekly([(7, 0, 60)], 0)
